title: Truncate with an ellipsis, in a Go text package that already counts runes
prompt: In text.go, add an exported function Truncate(s string, max int) string that shortens s to at most max runes. When it cuts anything, the result ends with the single rune … (counted toward max). max < 1 returns the empty string; strings that already fit are returned unchanged. Keep the module's existing style. Tests run with: go test ./...
